Components / Sources

Sources

The grouped sources behind an answer: a collapsible whose trigger reads the web original's Used N sources and whose rows compose the item primitive — title AND domain (UC-CHAT-05 AC-1), an optional caller-supplied favicon in the icon slot (RN has no favicon service without a new dep; the web row is a book icon anyway), and the platform link handler behind the scheme allowlist where the web anchor had target=_blank (AC-3). The PRD verdict is a collapsible list, not a table — there is no SourcesTable upstream.

  • v0.2.1
  • component
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/sources.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/sources.json
